select d.dept_id as id, d.dept_name as name from sys_dept d where d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0'
and d.dept_id in
#{departmentId}
and 1 = 0
order by d.order_num, d.dept_id limit 100

select count(1) from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and r.role_key = #{roleKey} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'

select count(1) from lab_laboratory l where l.id = #{laboratoryId} and l.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user active_user where active_user.user_id = #{userId} and active_user.status = '0' and active_user.del_flag = '0' ) and ( #{userId} = 1 or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.role_key in ('lab_manager', 'lab_safety_officer') and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and ( r.data_scope = '1' or (r.data_scope = '2' and exists ( select 1 from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id = r.role_id and rd.dept_id = l.dept_id )) or (r.data_scope = '3' and l.dept_id = u.dept_id) or (r.data_scope = '4' and exists ( select 1 from sys_dept scoped_dept where scoped_dept.dept_id = l.dept_id and scoped_dept.status = '0' and scoped_dept.del_flag = '0' and (scoped_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id or find_in_set(u.dept_id, scoped_dept.ancestors) > 0) )) or (r.data_scope = '5' and l.manager_id = #{userId}) ) ) )

select count(1) from sys_dept target_dept where target_dept.dept_id = #{departmentId} and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user active_user where active_user.user_id = #{userId} and active_user.status = '0' and active_user.del_flag = '0' ) and ( #{userId} = 1 or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and r.role_key in ('lab_manager', 'lab_safety_officer') and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and ( r.data_scope = '1' or (r.data_scope = '2' and exists ( select 1 from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id = r.role_id and rd.dept_id = target_dept.dept_id )) or (r.data_scope = '3' and target_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id) or (r.data_scope = '4' and (target_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id or find_in_set(u.dept_id, target_dept.ancestors) > 0)) or r.data_scope = '5' ) ) )

select count(1) from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.user_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.user_id = #{userId} and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and r.role_key in ('lab_student', 'lab_manager', 'lab_safety_officer', 'lab_repair_worker') and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = #{departmentId} and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0'
